content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 13/10/2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) for various project-based research positions under the IRD unit.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Project Assistant (Tech) under the specified project on 6G Wireless Systems.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available across the Junior Research Fellow and Project Assistant (Tech) positions in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position must possess a 1st class Masters and Bachelors degree in EE, ECE, or CSE fields.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Assistant (Tech)?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Project Assistant (Tech) post need a Bachelors degree in EE, ECE, or CSE along with at least one year of research experience in AI/ML or Wireless communication research.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 37,000/- p.m. plus HRA @27% up to Rs. 51,420/- p.m. plus HRA @27% depending upon the specific post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Jobs 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed applications by email is 13 October 2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Candidates need to download the specified form, fill it out, and send it along with documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications followed by an online interview for the shortlisted applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and website details?
faq.answer: You can check the official website at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec and find direct reference links in the important links section of this recruitment article.
